name: universal-office
description: Suíte Universal Office — editor de texto (Write), planilha eletrônica (Sheet) e apresentação (Slides) com compatibilidade de formato (.docx/.xlsx/.pptx) e renderização fiel.

scripts.install:all: npm run hooks:install && npm run fonts:sync && npm run install:converter && npm run install:fonts && npm run install:charts && npm run install:ui && npm install --prefix write && npm install --prefix sheet && npm install --prefix slides
scripts.install:converter: npm install --no-save --package-lock=false --prefix vendor/office-converter && npm run build --prefix vendor/office-converter
scripts.install:fonts: npm install --prefix shared/fonts && npm run build:fonts
scripts.install:charts: npm install --prefix shared/charts && npm run build:charts
scripts.install:ui: npm install --prefix shared/ui && npm run build:ui
scripts.build: npm run build:fonts && npm run build:charts && npm run build:ui && npm run build:converter && npm run build:write && npm run build:sheet && npm run build:slides
scripts.test: npm run test:fonts && npm run test:charts && npm run test:ui && npm run test:write && npm run test:sheet && npm run test:slides
